body: TotalEnergies TTE and KKR KKR signed an agreement to add 700 MW to their 50/50 U.S. renewable joint venture (JV), expanding the portfolio's total capacity to 2.1 GW.The $1.2B enterprise value transaction covers three utility-scale solar assets located in Texas and Ohio, which are expected to achieve commercial operation by the first quarter of 2027.Electricity generated from the portfolio is either pre-sold to third parties or will be marketed directly by TotalEnergies.TotalEnergies will continue to operate the solar facilities following the transaction's expected closing in 2026.The joint venture was originally formed by the two companies in 2025 with an initial capacity of 1.4 GW.DisclaimerContent provided by Seeking Alpha is intended for information purposes only, and that Seeking Alpha does not offer any personalist investment advice and is not a licensed securities dealer, broker, US investment adviser or investment bank.
